import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def task_func(df1, df2):
    merged_df = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="id", how="outer", suffixes=("_df1", "_df2"))

    df1_numeric_cols = [
        col for col in df1.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
        if col != "id"
    ]

    overlapping_cols = (set(df1.columns) & set(df2.columns)) - {"id"}
    scaled_cols = [
        f"{col}_df1" if col in overlapping_cols else col
        for col in df1_numeric_cols
    ]

    if scaled_cols:
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        merged_df[scaled_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(merged_df[scaled_cols])
        pair_plot = sns.pairplot(merged_df[scaled_cols])
    else:
        pair_plot = sns.PairGrid(pd.DataFrame())

    return merged_df, pair_plot
